verdicts.reason: A is just the banner spread out vertically. The shoe stays small, and the headline, subcopy and LIMITED badge drift apart with big, uneven gaps (about 80 px between lines), so the text column falls apart. There is also dead space above and below, and nothing has been rearranged for the new shape. B does rearrange: the headline is top-left, the shoe is enlarged and the bottom row reads copy, CTA, badge. But the shoe sits off-centre to the right and leaves an empty hole on the left. The headline is weak next to the huge shoe, and the LIMITED badge is stranded at the far right after the CTA instead of sitting with the product or the headline.
